rule.textEn: Motorboats and PWC: operators must be 18, except that 14- to 17-year-olds may operate after passing a state-approved boating safety course.
rule.textEs: Lanchas con motor y motos acuáticas: hay que tener 18 años, salvo los de 14 a 17 años que aprueben un curso de seguridad náutica aprobado por el estado.

minAge.note: Under 14 may not operate a motorboat or PWC; 14-17 only with the course; 18+ no course required.

sources.quote: In Colorado, anyone operating a motorboat - including personal watercraft such as Jet Skis - must be at least 18 years old.

Individuals aged 14–17 who wish to operate a motorized vessel are required to complete and pass a state-approved boating safety course. Courses may be taken in person, virtually, or fully online through an approved provider.
